messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #18412 blocked by CI. The 'model-integration-heavy-run' test times out ~12m in. 3 consecutive failures on staging. Need merge by EOD. Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/18412|PR#18412>

sam: Can you paste the failing job/step? I can grab logs.

alex: Job: build-stage-18. Here's last failure tail:
```
[2026-03-18T12:41:02Z] RUNNING: model-integration-heavy-run
[2026-03-18T12:53:14Z] ERROR: Timeout after 15m
Trace: ...
```

maria: I saw similar flakiness earlier — it spikes when the embedding index rebuild runs. Might be resource contention on shard3.

jen: @sam can you trigger targeted rerun on shard3? If it passes once we can merge. If it's consistently failing we should increase test timeout or split the heavy test.

sam: Triggering targeted rerun now (rerun-id: 43901)...

ci-bot: targeted_rerun 43901 started by sam — queue pos 2

sam: First rerun failed same timeout. Dumping full log: <https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/7751/log>

alex: Ugh. If rerun fails, I'd prefer to skip the heavy segment behind a flag and follow up. Need 1 approver to bump timeout for this flaky test. @maria @jen any objections?

maria: No objections. Bump timeout to 30m in test config is fine for now. Please add a TODO to track optimizations.

jen: +1 — approve changing timeout for this PR. Please add note in PR description and link an issue for follow-up.

alex: Thanks. @sam can you open a quick commit to increase timeout and push? Or I can if you want.

sam: Pushed timeout bump to 30m in test config, restarted CI.

ci-bot: build-stage-18 restarted by sam (build 7752)

ci-bot: build 7752 succeeded — all checks green

alex: Merged. I'll file ISSUE-451 to track splitting that heavy test. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria: Nice! :shipit:
